verifications.claim: Tax Day for 2026 is Wednesday, April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R8: 'Tax Day is this week, falling on Wednesday, April 15'; R6: '2026 tax season... is April 15, 2026'; R9: 'Tax Day 2026... federal tax deadline is April 15, 2026'; R2/R3/R4: 'April 15 deadline' or 'April 15, 2026' in 2026 context.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm April 15, 2026 as Tax Day/filing deadline; R8 explicitly states 'Wednesday'.

verifications.claim: April 15, 2026 is the deadline to file federal income tax returns for the 2025 tax year.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: '2026 tax deadlines... income... for 2025'; R8: 'for 2025 taxes'; R9: 'file their 2025 returns'; R2: 'April 15 deadline to file federal income tax returns' in 2026; R4: 'Calendar year filers... April 15, 2026'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly link April 15, 2026 filing deadline to 2025 tax year returns.

verifications.claim: April 15, 2026 is the deadline to pay any taxes owed to the IRS for the 2025 tax year.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'pay taxes due on April 15, 2026'; R6: 'Taxes owed must still be paid by April 15, 2026'; R4: 'pay any owed taxes by your original due date'; R3: 'April 15 – Individual taxes due'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state payment deadline is April 15, 2026 for taxes owed (implying 2025 year in context).

verifications.claim: Federal income tax returns must be filed or postmarked by April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'postmarked and deposited in the mail by the due date' (April 15, 2026); R8: 'April 15, 2026, postmark, or submitted online before midnight'; R9: 'Paper returns must be... postmarked... on the deadline'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm filing/postmark by April 15, 2026 for federal returns.

verifications.claim: Form 4868 is filed by April 15, 2026 for an extension until October 15, 2026 to file.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'File Form 4868... by the filing due date... until October 15'; R4: 'file Form 4868... by the original due date'; R6/R8/R9: 'Form 4868... by April 15... to October 15, 2026'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources precisely describe Form 4868 filed by April 15, 2026 for extension to October 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: Extensions to file are not extensions to pay.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'extension is only for filing... not for extra time to pay'; R4: 'extension... is not an extension of time to pay'; R6/R8: 'extension to file is not an extension to pay'.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple IRS and official sources directly state this distinction.

verifications.claim: Taxes owed must be paid by April 15, 2026 to avoid penalties.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'pay taxes due on April 15, 2026, to avoid penalties'; R6: 'paid by April 15, 2026, to avoid penalties'; R4/R8: similar payment by due date to avoid penalties.
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly require payment by April 15, 2026 to avoid penalties.
